freeze_rule: This file is a template. A field is frozen only when a non-null value AND its evidence binding are recorded after the outcome-blind corpus report exists; JSON null means UNBOUND, never a default and never a finding. No partial freeze, no in-place repair of a frozen record (a change creates a sibling version). Nothing here may be read as a claim of learned structure.
intended_consumer: Stage 0C (blind corpus report and Freeze R) in researches/PLAN-TAPE-ATLAS.md; then Stage 1 within-name geometry

lineage.immutable_graph: raw.index -> observations -> representation -> geometry -> optional lexicon -> human overlay -> anatomy -> hypothesis
lineage.pre_anatomy_boundary: Freeze R sits strictly between observations and geometry. It may read no outcome_*, censor, future_, ticket_constant or anatomy column, and no outcome/artifact label. anatomy@vN may attach only to occurrences whose representation and geometry carry a non-withdrawn Freeze-R record.
lineage.allowed_evidence: only the permitted outcome-blind summaries of PLAN-TAPE-ATLAS.md section 2 (counts; length/magnitude distributions; per-block/family/era/channel quantiles; duplicate/overlap and roster-census facts; no-outcome distance/density/neighbour/perturbation/surrogate statistics; resource/cost measurements)

closed_prior_methods.method: event-anchored flattened z-scored shape clustering (E1 flush touch, E2 thrust, E3 volume spike)
closed_prior_methods.closure: E1 EXHAUSTED 0.0411, E3 EXHAUSTED 0.0433, E2 INCONCLUSIVE_POWER (<2000 windows); the entire shape-clustering family is closed

closed_prior_methods.record: H018; PRE-REG-PATTERN-01/02 retain DTW as illustration only

no_resurrection: no all-minutes or event-anchored flattened shape k-means
no silhouette-selected partition presented as structure
no supervised outcome target inside the representation

metric_weights.balanced_reference_aggregation: fixed equal weight across standardized view distances

numeric_one_shot_gates.note: numeric one-shot gates are committed once, before any training run; they replace silhouette and do not require clusters

hand_views_meta.declaration_rule: exactly five principled hand views; no view is declared primary after seeing outcomes; neighbour overlap and pairwise distance agreement are published

magnitude_dominant.role: level, return/depth, raw attention intensity and duration

normalized_shape_dominant.role: declared scale-free path geometry; reference levels retained only as audit coordinates

duration_event_dominant.role: wall time, printed-bar duration, gaps/holes and change points

activity_microstructure_dominant.role: print/bar arrival, size/count/notional, condition and available quote geometry

balanced_multichannel_reference.role: fixed equal-weight combination of standardized view distances; never tuned into the best-looking geometry

learned_family.architecture: small masked-sequence temporal convolutional encoder (masked TCN)
learned_family.input_rule: selected raw/reference-relative minute channels plus explicit validity/coverage masks
learned_family.frozen_random_weights_comparator: same architecture with frozen random weights
learned_family.gate_failure_consequence: retires this learned family for v0 only; it does not retire the Atlas

tier_availability.rule: every result publishes which geometry the tier actually supports; a missing channel is never encoded as a market zero, and a null from a non-supporting tier can never enter a cross-tier mode gate

first_retrieval_proof.ask: nearest-100 retrieval on the canonical observation corpus
first_retrieval_proof.independent_units: (day,ticker,source_interval); neighbours must not share the query's own overlapping source interval
first_retrieval_proof.rare_path_reference_rule: rare/unique occurrences keep their own path/segment/clock/bar references whether or not they have neighbours; no neighbour fabrication
